notes: Exercises the single-agent BLRM posterior-toxicity transform logistic(log_alpha + exp(log_beta)*log(dose/ref_dose)) used verbatim in %blrm_main (lines 42-44), %blrm_stat (line 87) and %blrm_ewoc (line 159). The autoexec ships 60 deterministic mock posterior draws shaped like the PROC MCMC OUTPOST= data set (log_alpha, log_beta); the script applies the transform for four candidate doses and summarizes posterior DLT probability per dose with PROC MEANS (mean/std/quartiles). Output is monotone in dose, as the model requires.
